identity_and_freeze.source: Require HEAD==GITHUB_SHA and clean git status on the exact private branch. Snapshot every Git-tracked file plus complete three private-input trees before configure, before/after build; require equality.
identity_and_freeze.build_inputs: Before/after: selected primary CMake/CTest/Python/Git/PowerShell/Slang/as/dis/val/opt/cl/link/lib/MSBuild, each adjacent DLL, every fetched _deps/*-src file, configured cache/compiler/system/log and generated vcxproj/props/targets/sln files. Build outputs excluded.

identity_and_freeze.python_alias: Retain configured Python3 alias FileInfo length/link/attribute metadata separately from readable stream length/hash, plus nonempty sibling python.exe bytes. No substitution/interpreter-backup authority or claim that alias file length is executable size.
identity_and_freeze.mode: Windows FileAttributes/link metadata, not fabricated POSIX mode. Source/product reparse files refuse; only exact selected Python alias may be represented explicitly.
identity_and_freeze.limits: Not a complete host/SDK-header/installed-resource/transitive-DSO snapshot; no complete-host-tool-before claim. Configure dependency downloads precede before-build fetched-source freeze. CI30min job limit is not a measured aggregate RSS ownership guard.
